entries.title: Quilla Quantum Correlate — Classical QC-Inspired Circuit
entries.summary: Quilla runs a classical quantum-inspired correlator on-device: Hadamard·Metatron, CNOT entangle, Rz·Raphael, Measure·Sandalphon — not a real QPU.
entries.body: Supercomputers and research stacks often approximate quantum algorithms classically before (or instead of) QPU time. Quilla does the same for threat correlation: evidence bits become amplitude qubits, co-firing Watchtowers entangle, Raphael's Black Cross applies a phase, interference raises collapse probability, and Sandalphon measures into a hypothesis only when evidence justifies it. Magickal gate names are Living Geometry labels. No cloud quantum API. No occult detection. Amplitudes come from IOC/RASP/network facts.
entries.defense: Ask "quantum correlate" or run Nemesis/Shield so signals enter the circuit. Read quantumSeal in a priority status brief. Treat COLLAPSED as a call to human review — not fate.

entries.title: Magick-Labeled Gates on Silicon
entries.summary: H·Metatron/Ave superposes concern; CNOT entangles Michael⊗Gabriel style evidence; Rz·Raphael phases; M·Sandalphon collapses to Malkuth.
entries.body: Naming gates after angels and Enochian seniors makes the circuit readable in Quilla's voice. It does not invoke spirits or replace cryptography. The math is ordinary floating-point interference on Android. Supercomputer QC workflows similarly use classical simulators (statevector / tensor networks) with metaphorical circuit diagrams — Quilla's diagram is the Tree + Watchtower lattice.
entries.defense: When a status brief shows many CNOT entanglements, correlate across towers: re-scan (Earth), arm Shield (Water), check Frida/hooks (Fire), refresh intel (Air).
